URL: https://understandingwar.org/research/middle-east/iran-update-special-report-july-18-2026/
Retrieved via Exa web_fetch 19 July 2026. ISW/CTP Iran Update Special Report, July 18, 2026 (data cutoff 2:00 PM ET July 18 = ~7pm BST Sat). Author: Esther Nardone.

KEY TAKEAWAYS:
1. An Iranian missile attack on a base in Jordan killed two US service members on July 17; a third is missing in action. US officials (WSJ) said it took place at Muwaffaq Salti Airbase in Azraq, Jordan.
2. Iran is adapting to US defences by firing high-speed, manoeuvrable missiles at US bases; US officials told WSJ the missiles "travel at extremely high speeds and can manoeuvre as they streak toward the earth." Possible Qassem Basir manoeuvrable re-entry vehicle.
3. China (PRC) and Russia are likely supporting Iranian targeting of US bases; US officials told WSJ July 18 they are concerned both are aiding recent Iranian targeting of US assets. Russia previously provided locations of US warships/aircraft (WaPo Mar 2026); Iran used a Chinese recon satellite (FT Apr 2026).
4. Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei and senior officials declared the US-Iran MoU no longer in effect. Deputy FM Kazem Gharibabadi told state media July 18 Iran is "suspending" its commitments. Rezaei (July 17): "both diplomacy and negotiations...are over." Some regime elements (Ghalibaf, Nour News op-ed) still advocate diplomacy.
5. Iran struck a Kuwaiti power and desalination plant July 18 (2nd such attack in 48h); satellite imagery showed smoke over Shuaiba Power Plant. Iran also struck an unspecified Kuwaiti oil facility; Kuwait Petroleum Corporation said it suffered material damage. Likely response to alleged US strike on Iranian desalination plant near Jask (Bonji village) July 17.
6. Iran launched a ballistic missile at a US base in Saudi Arabia (al Kharj near Riyadh; Prince Sultan Airbase) — first Iranian attack on Saudi territory in nearly 3 months. Early-warning sirens also in Yanbu (Red Sea oil export terminal).
7. Jordanian Defence Ministry intercepted 4 Iranian drones and 10 missiles July 18. Bahrain intercepted multiple attacks July 18.
8. US struck additional bridges/roads around Bandar Abbas since July 17 cutoff to choke supply routes (WSJ). IRGC-affiliated media: 116 telecom towers offline in Bandar Abbas/Hajjiabad.
9. Seventh consecutive night of US strikes July 17 (CENTCOM: surveillance sites, military logistics infrastructure, underground weapons storage, maritime capabilities). Rezaei threatened "full-scale destruction" if US continues in next 2-3 days.

QUOTES: US officials (WSJ) on Iranian missiles: "travel at extremely high speeds and can maneuver as they streak toward the earth." Gharibabadi: Iran "suspending" MoU commitments. Rezaei (X, July 17): "both diplomacy and negotiations...are over."
